text_block_list.text:
While cleaning up after training, I 
spotted a suspicious figure...

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Hrmm, that girl over there gets stuck 
right there. And that girl... gets about 
10 stuck in her...

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, you found me☆ But don't you worry! I 
haven't poked you with a single needle 
yet.

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
I was just doing some mental training for 
the treatment, that's all! While 
envisioning the brilliant future of 
Umamusume! ☆

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Stop, stooop! Let's put the phone down 
first, okay?

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Are you really okay with losing Sasami 
Anshinzawa, the (self-proclaimed) national 
treasure of acupuncture, right here and 
now!?
choice_data_list:
...Because my student's safety is the top 
priority.

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
...Still, please believe just this. All I 
truly want from the bottom of my heart is 
for Umamusume to flourish and succeed...

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Take a look at the comments left on the 
website too! 'Thanks to the bamboo 
acupuncture, I won 1st place!' 'Ever since 
the treatment, every single day is pure 
bliss~♪'

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, so many joyful voices☆ ...Even if 
they're all addressed to Master!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Eeeek, you're letting me off the hook?! 
Look at you being so reasonable☆

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
...I know! As a thank-you, I'll give you a 
little poke! It's your golden chance to 
power up~!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
...If this works out... Wow, what a 
relief~☆

I declined the treatment, but I was able 
to learn just a little about acupuncture.
